question: After all this, did Jeroboam change his evil ways?
options: Yes, he tore down the golden calves
Yes, he went to worship in Jerusalem
No, he kept appointing priests for the high places from all sorts of people
Yes, he made the man of God his adviser
explanation: Even after this, Jeroboam did not change his evil ways; this became the sin of his house that led to its downfall and destruction.
